name: comparison_tree_eval_bind
lines: ⊢ comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind T f) = comparison_tree_eval v (f (comparison_tree_eval v T))
ihl : comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind l f) = comparison_tree_eval v (f (comparison_tree_eval v l))
ihr : comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind r f) = comparison_tree_eval v (f (comparison_tree_eval v r))
⊢ comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind (ComparisonTree.branch i j l r) f) =
comparison_tree_eval v (f (comparison_tree_eval v (ComparisonTree.branch i j l r)))
⊢ (if v i < v j then comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind l f)
comparison_tree_eval v (f (if v i < v j then comparison_tree_eval v l else comparison_tree_eval v r))
⊢ comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind l f) = comparison_tree_eval v (f (comparison_tree_eval v l))
⊢ comparison_tree_eval v (comparison_tree_bind r f) = comparison_tree_eval v (f (comparison_tree_eval v r))

steps.tactic:
induction T with
| leaf a => rfl
| branch i j l r ihl ihr =>
  simp only [comparison_tree_bind, comparison_tree_eval]
  split
  · exact ihl
  · exact ihr
